name: cudafast-nemotron35-lightning-30b-a3b
description: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B CUDA text inference speedup track on DGX Spark (GB10, sm_121). Target: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4 @ bee7596271d1495f6992ae224aefde4410e816b8, a ModelOpt mixed-precision checkpoint (NVFP4 W4A16 experts and lm_head, FP8 Mamba in/out projections, FP8 KV cache) of a 52-layer hybrid: 23 Mamba-2 layers, 23 MoE layers (128 routed experts, 6 per token, plus a shared expert) and 6 attention layers. The engine is vLLM v0.27.1, its Python package VENDORED at vllm/ and layered over the pinned container's compiled extensions; the scored binary is the Engine Protocol v1 adapter (harness/protocol-adapter) attached to one vLLM resident per leg (harness/vllm_resident). There is exactly ONE speculative arm: the NATIVE MTP layer embedded in the pinned checkpoint (mtp.* tensors, BF16), run by vLLM's mtp method at a participant-selected depth 1 to 6. No submission carries head weights. The target quantization is frozen. Scoring is single-stream and paired with a per-box baseline: 3 pairs of one serial-control leg on the reference tree and one candidate leg, one pair per prompt of the fixture's live_goldens (three chat-template coding prompts of 496 tokens, one unmeasured prefill warm-up pass, 128-step decode); composite = prefill_gain^0.25 * decode_gain^0.75 for each pair, where decode is the decode window (decode-run time / N, no seed prefill); the score is the mean of the 3 per-pair composites, floors 0.95 on every pair, ceiling 5.0. fixtures/nemotron35_lightning_30b_a3b_track.json is the authority; editablePaths is the authority for what a submission may change.
